title: Remote MAC Not Learned — RT Import Broken VNI 10011 on dc1-leaf1a
symptom: Remote MAC from dc1-leaf2a not present in VNI 10011 table on dc1-leaf1a. Local MAC present. EVPN sessions Established.
root_cause: RT import for VLAN 11 changed to 10011:77777 on dc1-leaf1a. dc1-leaf2a exports 10011:10011 which dc1-leaf1a no longer imports.
fix_command:
router bgp 65101
vlan 11
no route-target export 10011:10011
no route-target import 10011:77777
route-target both 10011:10011
